reviewedRevision: 2124ed5 plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-sector shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. It passed; two cheap LOW fixes (level 20 shown as cleared, stuck-miner hint priority) were verified by re-running the reviewer's own pilot, blind and correctness scripts, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own bot (public getState only, cracks, air and stuck miners seen 0.25 s or 0.35 s late) cleared 60 of 60 levels at each delay with no lives lost when it braced before risky digs, and 20 of 20 at 30 and 120 Hz; a hasty variant that only braces once a crack shows cleared 48 of 48 at 0.25 s and 46 of 48 at 0.35 s, and a careless digger that never places beams cleared levels 5-10 but lost every mastery level. Blind play (idle, mash, random and hold-plus-alternate patterns at 0.1-2 s periods) cleared 0 of 4,980 runs per level. Final states matched at 30, 60 and 120 Hz on levels 1, 7, 12, 16 and 20, a hostile fuzz ended at most once with no NaN, broken progress stores were safe, and no soft-lock was found. On the final files the same pilot cleared 60 of 60 at 0.35 s, blind play stayed at 0%, and the correctness script passed.

findings.observation: Only 3 sectors, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven mines (teaching 1-5, mid 6-10, combination 11-15, mastery 16-20) with rock layers, loose soil, air tanks, beams and per-level crack fuses from 4 s to 2.5 s shown on screen, accurate EN/ZH tips, a level select and env.progress continue, and the 1,108-line file is split into seven modules.

Review findings: clearing level 20 saved progress as 20, so the select screen never marked it cleared, and after a cave-in the 'Miner stuck: dig a path to them' hint was hidden behind 'Space: dig' when facing earth. Winning level 20 now saves 21 (the state and cursor stay capped at 20, with a completed flag), and the stuck-miner hint takes priority in EN and ZH.

openNotes: Mastery is harder mainly through planning: longer tunnels, fewer beams and more restock trips. A careful planner clears it without hits, while careless digging loses every mastery level.
There is no time pressure: surface air refills for free and there is no level timer, so the shorter mastery fuses matter only after a mistaken dig.
The level banner covers the top two rows for about 2 s at the start of each level.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start and the language toggle, synthetic in-page keys driven only by the status-line prompt; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened level 1 of 20 with the lift, the stranded miner, air, beams and lives visible and the prompt 'Space: dig'.
Win: following only the prompts (Space: dig, X: wake the miner, Lead the miners to the lift) cleared level 1 with 'Level clear! Next mine' and opened level 2 of 20 with score 1180.
Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the level select showed level 1 as 已通关 and level 2 unlocked, with touch buttons 左, 上, 下, 右, 挖掘 and 支架 / 带人.
Not covered in the browser: a cave-in, a loss and the level 20 cleared marker; the reviewer's scripts and the quality tests cover them.
